'''''Trigonella''''' is a genus from the family [[Fabaceae]]. The best known member is the herb [[fenugreek]]. Members of the genus occur naturally in the Canary Islands, southern Europe, non{{nbh}}tropical Africa, western and central Asia, the Indian subcontinent, and Australia.<ref name = "AllegedlyPoWOknowsall" />
